sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
So how do you play Bubble Wooble? The game is surprisingly simple. All you need to do is click on the bubble that encases the monster you want to free. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not quite that simple. The monsters are surrounded by bubbles of different colors and sizes, each with its own speed and trajectory. The goal is to pop the bubbles in the correct order to free the monster and guide it to its home. The twist is that some bubbles are more difficult to pop than others, and some are even moving at high speeds, making it a real challenge to navigate the board.

But that's not all - the game also features obstacles like walls and other blocks that you need to navigate around in order to free the monsters. And to make things even more interesting, the game has a timer that counts down from 60 seconds, adding an element of pressure to the proceedings. So what do you do? You'll need to time your moves just right and use your wits to outmaneuver the obstacles and navigate the board.

But don't worry if you're not sure where to start - the game is designed to be easy to pick up, and the controls are simple and intuitive. Whether you're using a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, you'll be popping bubbles and guiding monsters to their homes in no time.
